payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP over numbers 1..max_val: dp[x]=cnt[x]+max_{d|x}dp[d]; iterate i increasing, update multiples j to propagate optimal chains.
payload.rationale: The code uses a single DP array indexed by value, computing longest divisible chain via divisor/multiple updates. No 2D state, recursion, bitmask, or tree; sorting is incidental.
